keyframes.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Asset type: PRODUCTION SOURCE DRAWINGS for a 2D game growth animation. Reference 1 is the LOCKED level-3 pebble stone den; reference 2 is the LOCKED level-4 stone den. Make a strict TWO COLUMNS BY TWO ROWS sheet with FOUR COMPLETE intermediate structure drawings on true transparent RGBA. These drawings will supply actual gate panels, hidden stone surfaces and assembly poses to the animation, not a presentation. No text, labels, borders, ground or drop shadows. Same frontal three-quarter view, warm faceted ochre sandstone, cream carved stone, brass/bronze machinery, cyan gems, dark clean teal outlines, top-left light. Preserve both references' exact design language. Common bottom-center footing and common scale; level 4 grows taller through new stonework rather than global zoom. Keep each whole object fully within its cell with generous empty transparent gutters.
TOP LEFT, 0.75 seconds: EXACT reference1 level3 with its stone gate fully LOWERED to the doorway bottom. The original hanging horizontal stone beam is the bottom edge of one complete tall solid ochre stone door panel behind the rocks. Show the entire uninterrupted panel above that beam, no second horizontal lintel floating across the panel. Original wooden winch and rope remain connected, right counterweight raised.
TOP RIGHT, 1.55 seconds: transitional expanded rough stone framework. The outer rock shell and crown have moved into reference2's taller wider final arrangement, with fully painted stones and formerly hidden internal surfaces. The old closed stone door remains at the central entrance. NO cream decorative arch, jeweled pilasters, gold gears, bronze frame or stairs yet. Old wooden winch has moved behind the upper right rocks so it is fully occluded; no abandoned external weight. This drawing supplies the complete bare level4 rear stone shell, keeping reference2 crown and shoulder rocks exactly.
BOTTOM LEFT, 2.25 seconds: reference2 masonry is assembled around a CLOSED plain ochre stone gate: exact front steps, black plinths, cream jeweled pilasters and carved cream arch. Omit only the upper bronze gears, chain, lifting frame and decorated gate top beam, leaving complete bare stone faces at those mounting locations. No missing holes or cut surfaces. The rear rocks match TOP RIGHT exactly.
BOTTOM RIGHT, 2.80 seconds: EXACT reference2 fully assembled but stone gate CLOSED. The complete gate slab fills the aperture behind the arch, solid warm ivory sandstone. The decorated beam with its single central round gold medallion has descended WITH the gate to its bottom edge just above the threshold; chains extend continuously from the two upper gears to that moving beam. Do not leave a duplicate beam above the opening or put a second medallion on the door. Keep both original gears, bronze brackets, jeweled pillars, arch and steps exact. One medallion total. No inventions, melted stone, rubbery hardware, severed ropes, floating fragments, extra architecture or faded silhouettes.

supplementalSource.prompt:
Use case: precise-object-edit. Production layered SOURCE ART for animating these EXACT 2D stone dens. Reference1 is locked level3. Reference2 is locked level4. Make a strict THREE COLUMNS BY TWO ROWS transparent attachment atlas with SIX disconnected objects. Wide empty gutters, each object entirely contained in its cell; no text, labels, borders, background or shadows. Match the exact source frontal three-quarter camera, warm faceted sandstone, ivory stone, rich bronze, clean dark teal contours, top-left lighting. Finish ALL hidden surfaces. These will be extracted into real moving layers.
TOP LEFT: ONE complete tall rectangular solid OCHRE SANDSTONE gate slab for reference1. Plain broad golden facets, slightly rounded corners. Full uninterrupted slab, approximately width 170 to height 150 ratio. No horizontal bottom beam, no ropes, no winch, no other stones. Its lower edge will sit behind the original reference1 moving hanging beam.
TOP MIDDLE: ONE complete taller plain IVORY SANDSTONE gate slab for reference2, solid broad warm pale facets, approximately width 210 to height 220 ratio. It extends behind the arch. No arch, frame, beam, medallion, chains, gear, border decoration or extra emblem. Complete rectangular slab with gently rounded corners and clean thick outline.
TOP RIGHT: ONLY reference2 central broad horizontal golden sandstone WALL BLOCK behind its gears and moving beam, with all formerly hidden facets fully painted. No metal, cream masonry, door, mechanism or gear. A complete low wide solid faceted stone block, source proportions.
BOTTOM LEFT: the complete exact OUTER SANDSTONE ROCK SHELL of reference2, including its cracked crown boulder, shoulder rocks and low side rocks. REMOVE every cream arch stone, front pilaster, cyan gem, black pedestal, stair, bronze bracket, gear, chain and gate. Finish the exposed stone supports behind the removed objects. The large inner doorway is entirely transparent, not filled with a new door or stone wall. Preserve exact reference2 overall squat silhouette and exact crown/side rock placement; no redesign or additional tall courses of rocks.
BOTTOM MIDDLE: exact reference2 LEFT toothed bronze gear ALONE, complete circular silhouette and original tooth count, central axle cap, full teeth behind where the bracket previously occluded them. No bracket, chain, wall or stone behind it.
BOTTOM RIGHT: exact reference2 RIGHT toothed bronze gear ALONE with same requirements. The gear axle is centered; no detached pieces or flat cut edges. Both gears retain the same source lighting, not mirrored highlights. No melted hardware or invented architecture.

hiddenSurfaces.prompt:

Reference1 is the locked final level4 architecture; reference2 establishes the assembly motion, not a new design. Make a strict THREE columns by THREE rows atlas, NINE separate disconnected objects, true transparent RGBA with very wide transparent gutters and no labels, text, ground or shadows. Match exact frontal three-quarter camera, soft faceted sandstone, cream stone, bronze and crisp dark teal outlines. Each part must be complete behind overlapping neighbors, no cut edges, fully painted hidden surfaces. No complete nests.
ROW1 LEFT: complete LEFT ivory pilaster of reference1, from rounded cream capital through the tapered ivory shaft, original cyan gem and bronze bands, to the complete broad black stone pedestal and lower bronze edging. No surrounding sandstone, stairs, arch, chains or mechanisms. ROW1 MIDDLE: corresponding complete RIGHT pilaster with its own original lighting, no mirrored highlights. ROW1 RIGHT: complete IVORY ARCH RING only, all original wedge stones forming the exact reference1 arch including both lower jambs, full hidden lower ends behind the pilasters. Transparent inside, no gate, beam, medallion, gears, pillars or stairs.
ROW2 LEFT: complete LEFT BRONZE LIFTING SUPPORT FRAME only from reference1, including curved upper bracket, bolted vertical support and lower diagonal support. REMOVE the toothed gear, all chains, stone and horizontal moving gate beam; finish the bronze frame behind them. ROW2 MIDDLE: corresponding RIGHT BRONZE SUPPORT FRAME, same requirements, original lighting. ROW2 RIGHT: ONE complete horizontal MOVING STONE GATE BEAM of reference1, including its single centered golden strap and round medallion, both rounded end faces and two chain mounting eyes. NO chains, full door panel, gears, arch or supports. Exactly one medallion on the beam.
ROW3 LEFT: complete cracked CROWN BOULDER of reference1 as ONE whole solid rock, no bronze arches, gears or surrounding rocks. Exact low broad crown silhouette, complete lower hidden surface. ROW3 MIDDLE: complete LEFT UPPER SHOULDER BOULDER from reference1, full back contour behind pilaster and bronze frame. ROW3 RIGHT: corresponding RIGHT UPPER SHOULDER BOULDER. Stones remain rigid, broad smooth facets, clean closed silhouettes. Do not invent new ornament, additional joints, feet, wheels or other objects.

backgroundRestoration.prompt: Use case: precise-object-edit. Edit target: reference1, the 512x512 level4 stone-den sprite. Reference2 is the same locked original at higher resolution for material detail. Draw a PRODUCTION BACKGROUND RESTORATION SOURCE for a layered animation. Keep the EXACT existing camera, full silhouette, scale, footprint, crown boulder, side rock arrangement, cream arch, jeweled ivory pilasters, black bases, front stairs, dark cave interior, outlines, warm colors and top-left light. Change ONLY the mechanical equipment area in the UPPER CENTRAL region of the nest. REMOVE ALL the bronze lift-support frames on both upper sides, both toothed gears, both chains, and the suspended horizontal ivory gate beam including its central gold strap/medallion. Paint the formerly concealed SANDSTONE WALL behind all those removed objects as complete continuous broad natural golden rock faces, structurally connecting the unchanged crown to the unchanged ivory doorway arch. No holes or dark outlines shaped like the removed machinery. No remaining bolts, gold flecks, chains, gear teeth, frame fragments, duplicated outlines or white stone chips where metal was. Do not add a second arch, pillars, upright columns, huge rectangular plaques or new rock courses. Preserve the existing low squat structure. The unchanged cream arch below and crown above naturally frame a solid, coherent warm ochre stone wall that will sit BEHIND the separate moving machinery. Keep all other pixels/design as close as possible to reference1. Single complete nest source, centered and fully visible, genuine alpha transparency, no backdrop or drop shadow, no labels or text. This is an actual hidden-surface background for the rig, not a preview or new design.
